notes.zh-CN: 修复 MiMo 只显示用户消息、没有回复的问题：未保存模型的新旧会话会在发送前应用并保存 CLI 最近使用的模型与提供商，保留明确选择的模型；空回复会提示核对提供商与凭证，不再静默结束。包含 0.56.2 手机实时同步修复。macOS 为 universal 包；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 沿用历史 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队注册设备。
notes.en: Fixed MiMo conversations ending without a reply. Chats without a saved model now apply and save the CLI’s recent model and provider before sending; explicit model choices are preserved. Empty replies show guidance for checking the provider and credentials. Includes the 0.56.2 mobile sync fix. macOS is universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK retains its previous debug signing identity; the IPA is signed for development on registered team devices only.
